messages:
Maria: heads-up — after last night's sidecar rollout in eu-west-1 we're seeing broken trace correlation between api-gateway and inference-runtime. spans arrive at collector but there is no parent api span, so traces look fragmented.
Ajay: any alerts? what dashboards show?
Maria: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/traces-overview?orgId=1
Prometheus metric: opentelemetry_exporter_dropped_spans_total jumped from 0 to ~1200 in 10m.
Maria: sample logs from otel-sidecar:
```
2026-03-17T22:12:05Z WARN  otel_sidecar::propagation > missing traceparent header
2026-03-17T22:12:06Z WARN  otel_sidecar::exporter > failed to attach parent span: context not found
```
Claire: we changed OTEL_PROPAGATORS to "b3" in the sidecar image (to match an old test), but runtime uses W3C traceparent. header mismatch.
Ajay: are headers being rewritten by the envoy ingress? any lowercasing or truncation?
Maria: envoy is set to normalize headers; but I noticed the sidecar also sets OTEL_TRACE_HEADERS=TRACEPARENT;TRACE_STATE in the container env — maybe conflicting.
Tom: consequence: our latency SLO dashboards show spikes but those were actually mis-correlated requests. Ops people got paged for high p99.
Priya: quick mitigations:
- rollback sidecar to previous image (canary) — Ajay can do this?
- update Grafana alert to silence the noisy alert for 30m
- add dual-propagator support (w3c + b3) in SDK patch and add e2e to devex tests
Ajay: rolling back canary now.
k8s-deploy-bot: rollout status: daemonset/opentelemetry-sidecar "revision 175 -> 174" complete
devex-bot: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/opentelemetry-sidecar/issues/482
Maria: small SDK fix in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rt-sdk/pull/901 (adds automatic propagator fallback). I'm running e2e locally.
Claire: also toggled ingress config to pass-through traceparent header without rewriting.
Tom: once correlation looks good we should update the SLO dashboard to join spans by trace_id; iirc we already have a grafana panel but it's not used by paging rules.
Priya: I'll open a follow-up to add a synthetic that asserts span-linking for api->runtime at deployment time.
Maria: thanks all — keeping this thread updated. :thumbsup:
Ajay: confirmed: drop metrics back to baseline. closing page noise.
Maria: leaving follow-up action items in the issue.
